Collect {icon:Event_Currency_Overwatch, 1.8} Eye of the Overwatch currency and use them to claim themed cosmetics.
{icon:bullet}Elite and Champion monsters have a chance to drop {icon:Event_Currency_Overwatch, 1.8} Eye of the Overwatch currency upon being slain. 
{icon:bullet}Claim all rewards to unlock the {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} Bonus reward.
